name: Dead Men Walking

features.name: Fire pits
features.description: Three pits, each tied to a base-game feature.

features.name: Dead Man's March
features.description: Triggered by a fully visible xNudge Wild.

features.name: Dead Man's Gold
features.description: Three to five bonus symbols set the spin count.

review:
A 5x3 game with three fire pits above the reels, each linked to a different base-game feature. Stacked xNudge wilds gain +1 per nudge and, once fully visible, trigger Dead Man's March.

xWays and xSplit add more ways and symbols, and three, four or five bonus symbols give the matching number of Dead Man's Gold spins. Extreme volatility, 25,313x max and a slightly higher 96.2% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
